quest.title: Twisted Extension
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Primogem x20, Mora x25000

dialogues.speaker: Quenin
dialogues.text: Ah, this place... Few visit it... After all, it's dangerous here.

dialogues.speaker: Quenin
dialogues.text: Are you with the adventure team too...? Hmph, they say the shadow of a black serpent has descended from the Tonatiuh... You should be careful.

dialogues.speaker: Quenin
dialogues.text: Or better, leave while you can. There are inhuman things, ha, hiding within the team... Those voices, those curses... so noisy...

dialogues.speaker: Quenin
dialogues.text: It's pretty quiet around here thanks to the waterfall. Haha... The roar of the falls drowns out everything else, so you can't hear a thing.

dialogues.speaker: Quenin's Diary
dialogues.text: (A torn page, with neatly written words at the beginning...)

dialogues.speaker: Quenin's Diary
dialogues.text: "...Abyss monsters are growing in number, as expected... The adventure team has failed in the end, and a planned retreat is in progress."

dialogues.speaker: Quenin's Diary
dialogues.text: "We must ensure the remaining members can evacuate safely. Be wary of those who vanish at night, or return from places devoid of light."

dialogues.speaker: Quenin's Diary
dialogues.text: "...The Abyss monsters are appearing more frequently. The stronghold may be discovered soon, but before that..."

dialogues.speaker: Quenin's Diary
dialogues.text: (The handwriting becomes shaky and distorted...)

dialogues.speaker: Quenin's Diary
dialogues.text: "Ah, it's cold... So cold... There, over there, blood is draining..."

dialogues.speaker: Quenin's Diary
dialogues.text: "The sound of the waterfall, so loud... yes, this is good. As long as... under the waterfall, it'll be quiet there... pale faces, opened mouths, drained blood..."

dialogues.speaker: Quenin's Diary
dialogues.text: "Just there... just... there... something... something is there..."

dialogues.speaker: Quenin's Diary
dialogues.text: "Under the waterfall under the waterfall under the waterfall under the waterfall under the waterfall under the waterfall..."

talks.objective: Explore the bottom of the waterfall
Investigate the space beneath the waterfall

dialogues.speaker: Cold Body
dialogues.text: (The cold, statue-like body of one resembling Quenin, somehow preserved without decay, seems frozen in time....)

dialogues.speaker: Cold Body
dialogues.text: (And judging by the surroundings, it has remained in this state for a long time...)

talks.objective: Find the source of the voice
Defeat the entity that looks like Quenin

dialogues.speaker: Quenin
dialogues.text: The waterfall, haha... The roar of the falls drowns out everything else, so you can't hear a thing.

dialogues.speaker: Quenin
dialogues.text: Oh, it's you. Need anything?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Nope, don't need anything.

dialogues.speaker: Quenin
dialogues.text: Is that so... Ah, then take my advice, brave warrior. Leave here quickly.

dialogues.speaker: Quenin
dialogues.text: The waterfall, haha... The roar of the falls drowns out everything else, so you can't hear a thing.

dialogues.speaker: Quenin
dialogues.text: Oh, it's you. Need anything?

response.speaker: Quenin
response.text: I'm... a warrior of the adventure team. Not one as mighty as our leader, Lord Taika, but I do have my strengths.

response.speaker: Quenin
response.text: I guard our camp... Sometimes, when I can't sleep at night, I patrol to keep the camp safe.

response.speaker: Quenin
response.text: Now, I don't know when it started, but there have been fewer and fewer people in camp every day... Huh, wait. Strange... Why am I here now?

response.speaker: Quenin
response.text: Is that so... Ah, then take my advice, brave warrior. Leave here quickly.

response.speaker: Quenin
response.text: Now, I don't know when it started, but there have been fewer and fewer people in camp every day... Huh, wait. Strange... Why am I here now?

response.speaker: Quenin
response.text: Yes, and only here at the waterfall can the sound of water drown them out...

response.speaker: Quenin
response.text: Can't you hear it? Someone whimpers by your ear, like one who is dying but cannot scream, making only the sound of their lungs struggling for air.

response.speaker: Quenin
response.text: And then, you will see a pale face, staring at you with anger. A face... like your own.

response.speaker: Quenin
response.text: Ah, only at the waterfall, only there can I escape those haunting sounds. Hehe, can't you hear them...

response.speaker: Quenin
response.text: Stay here for too long, brave warrior, and you might end up like me. So, leave while you can.

response.speaker: Quenin
